проверьте, что о вас видно в реестре ФОП: check what can be seen about you in Ukraine’s sole-trader register, court-decision databases and property listings; in Georgia, in the public registry and on classified-ad sites.

роль брокеров в Украине и Грузии играют: in Ukraine and Georgia, the role of data brokers is played by Telegram lookup bots and leaked databases: a phone number is enough to find a name, addresses and connections. Тбилиси зимой – не Киев. Днём +4…+8, ноч: Tbilisi in winter is not Kyiv. +4…+8 °C by day, around zero at night, −3…−6 in a cold January week; snow falls a few times a winter and melts within a day, and recent winters have been almost dry. January is the driest month of the year, with more sunny days than Kyiv. But there are three things Kyiv doesn’t prepare you for: cold houses, smog and short days. There’s almost no central heating – a gas boiler or air conditioner does the job, the old buildings of Vera and Sololaki are draughty, and +17 indoors when it’s +6 outside is normal unless you spend 150–250 GEL a month on heating. By February the air in the lowland by the river stagnates, and Tbilisi regularly ranks among Europe’s worst cities for air quality – Vake and Saburtalo are higher up and breathe easier. The sun rises at 8:30 and sets at 18:00.
Батуми зимой – другая история: теплее (+: Batumi in winter is a different story: warmer (+8…+12 by day), but from November to April it rains for days on end, wind blows off the sea, there are storms, and half the city is closed until May; new builds by the sea stand empty and cold, and you’ll heat with an air conditioner. Wintering in Batumi only makes sense if you love the sea in any weather and quiet. For your first winter in Georgia, choose Tbilisi.
Зато у зимы здесь есть то, чего нет у ки: On the other hand, winter here has things Kyiv’s doesn’t. The ski season at all resorts opens on 20 December and runs until mid-April: Gudauri is 120 km and 2.5 hours from Tbilisi, a minibus from Didube 20–30 GEL, a day ski pass about 70 GEL, rental 40–80 GEL; Bakuriani is quieter and cheaper (ski pass 55 GEL). The Abanotubani sulphur baths are the city’s greatest pleasure in winter. From mid-December to 7 January the city is strung with lights; 1–2 and 7 January are days off, 14 January is the Old New Year, 19 January is Epiphany; cafés and shops are open on these days, government offices aren’t. Kakheti in winter is empty and mild: wine cellars are open and there are no tourists.

Люди – за нас, власть – нет. Это главное: The people are on our side; the government isn’t. That’s the main thing to understand about Georgia in 2026. On the street a Ukrainian flag hangs on every other bar, a taxi driver will hear Ukrainian and say “Slava Ukraini”, and Russians in the same bar may be asked to sign a “visa” condemning Putin. Russian is the lingua franca here: you’ll hear it everywhere, including from relocants themselves. For a Ukrainian woman this means two things: speaking Russian is safe and normal, but in a firmly pro-Ukrainian place a single word in Ukrainian or “I’m from Ukraine” instantly changes the tone and melts the chill – there’s no need, and no point, in passing yourself off as Russian.

These are isolated incidents, not a pattern; since January 2022, insulting the flag or coat of arms of a state with which Georgia has diplomatic relations carries a 1,000 GEL fine.

For you as a foreigner, the main risk in any escalation isn’t your opponent but your migration record: a fight or a scene involving a foreign woman is grounds for a check and, at worst, deportation, while a local would get away with it. So: skip political arguments with drunk people; if someone harasses or threatens you, call 112 (the police really do come), but no physical confrontation. You’re among friends, but don’t expect Georgia to deal with Russians on your behalf.
Свой круг: с чего начать: Your own circle: where to start
How many of us there are.
Около 30 000 граждан Украины, из них ~2: About 30,000 Ukrainian citizens, of whom ~25,000 have refugee status and about 6,300 have residence permits (figures from Prime Minister Kobakhidze, 2026). Of the 220,000 who arrived in 2022, few remain: most moved on to the EU, where there are benefits and jobs. Those who stayed are mostly women with children, remote workers and people with family here.

Если вы из Киева или Днепра и привыкли: If you’re from Kyiv or Dnipro and used to going out – you’ll be fine in Tbilisi. Local young people are pro-European, speak English, stood at the protests in winter 2024–2025 and treat Ukrainians as “one of us”. Going out – Fabrika, bars in Vera and Sololaki, the clubs Bassiani, KHIDI, Left Bank. There’s no curfew – after Kyiv it feels like freedom. ВНЖ: виды и условия 2026: Residence permits: types and conditions in 2026
Не обязанность, а способ остаться дольше: Not an obligation, but a way to stay longer than a year
Временный ВНЖ теперь выдаётся на срок до: Temporary residence permits are now issued for up to 5 years for adults and up to 4 years for children (Law No. 1120 of 26.11.2025). Permanent residence comes after 10 years of continuous residence on a temporary permit (years of study and medical treatment don’t count) or through close kinship with a Georgian citizen. Applications are filed at the Public Service Hall (Public Service Development Agency, SDA) or online via my.gov.ge.
Подавайте не позже чем за 40 дней до кон: Apply no later than 40 days before your visa-free period ends; the fastest routes are the IT residence permit and sole-trader registration.
Год безвиза считается с даты въезда. Зая: The visa-free year is counted from your entry date. Residence applications are accepted no later than 40 days before it ends, and you become a tax resident after 183 days – so if you decide to stay, sort out your grounds for residence and sole-trader registration in the first month after deciding, not the last.
Для большинства украинцев на удалёнке ра: For most Ukrainians working remotely, there’s one practical route: the first year visa-free, a sole-trader registration with “small business” status in parallel, and a business residence permit by the end of the year. The IT residence permit is faster but requires proven experience and income.
Отказы по «соображениям безопасности» бе: Refusals on “security grounds” without explanation are common practice; appeals are possible but rarely succeed.
Для подачи нужны договор аренды или собс: To apply you need a lease or property ownership, proof of income, and notarised translations of documents into Georgian.
Срок рассмотрения и пошлина зависят от т: Processing time and fees depend on the tariff (usually 10–30 days); current amounts are on sda.gov.ge.
Подаваться надо не менее чем за 40 дней: You must apply at least 40 days before your legal stay ends.
С 1 марта 2026 – сначала разрешение, пот: Since 1 March 2026 – permit first, income second
С 1 марта 2026 г. иностранец без ПМЖ мож: Since 1 March 2026, a foreigner without permanent residence can only earn money legally in Georgia under two conditions: a work permit and a residence status – a residence permit or a D1 work visa. This applies to employees, sole traders and the self-employed alike. Those already working for a Georgian company as of 1 March 2026 have a transition period until 1 January 2027.
Заявку подают онлайн на портале Министе: You apply online on the Labour Ministry portal (for sole traders and the self-employed – self-employment.moh.gov.ge): a CV, passport, business plan or turnover documents; then a video interview with the Employment Support Agency in Georgian or English. Emails come from self-employment@moh.gov.ge – check your spam. For the first five years the permit is renewed annually; apply no later than 30 days before it expires – after that the system will block the application. The fine for working without a permit is 2,000 GEL, doubled for a repeat offence.
Удалёнка на Украину или ЕС – без разреше: Remote work for Ukraine or the EU – no permits needed. Your first Georgian client or employer – only after sole-trader registration or a work permit.
Если вы работаете полностью дистанционн: If you work fully remotely and only for foreign clients (a Ukrainian or European employer), you don’t need a work permit. But as soon as a Georgian client or employer appears, the rule applies.
Лимит оборота – 500 000 GEL (≈ 185 000 $: Turnover limit – 500,000 GEL (≈ $185,000) a year; above that – 3% and the risk of losing the status. Without the status, income tax is 20%.
Расходы налог не уменьшают; нужно вести: Expenses don’t reduce the tax; you need to keep an accounting log.
Запрещённые для 1 % виды: консалтинг, юр: Activities excluded from the 1% regime: consulting, legal and medical services, rentals, financial activities, etc. – check the list on rs.ge. IT development, design and analytics qualify.
Банки всё чаще запрашивают договоры с кл: Banks increasingly ask for contracts with clients and proof of the source of funds.
После 183 дней в Грузии за 12 месяцев в: After 183 days in Georgia within 12 months you become a tax resident. Individuals’ foreign-source income is mostly not taxed in Georgia (territorial principle), but Ukraine and Georgia have a double-taxation treaty – discuss your status in Ukraine with an accountant.
